settings.heading: Returns & Refunds
settings.intro: We want every order to be perfect. Here's what to do if something isn't right.
settings.policy_text: As our products are perishable, we follow a No Return, No Refund Policy. However, if your order arrives damaged or you receive the wrong items, just reach out to us — we'll make it right.
settings.help_text: You may request a refund or replacement under the following conditions.
settings.contact_hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, excluding public holidays.

settings.title: Damaged in Delivery
settings.text: If your order arrives damaged, contact us and we'll make it right.

settings.title: Wrong Items Received
settings.text: If we packed the wrong products, reach out immediately and we'll fix it.

settings.title: Send Photos & Description
settings.text: Include clear photographs and a description of the issue.

settings.title: We Resolve Within 1–2 Days
settings.text: Replacements and refunds are processed within 1–2 business days.

settings.title: 48-Hour Window
settings.text: All claims must be submitted within 48 hours of receiving your order.

settings.title: Documentation Required
settings.text: Claims must include a description and photograph(s) of the issue.

settings.title: 1–2 Business Days
settings.text: Replacements and refunds are processed within 1–2 business days once approved.

settings.title: Right to Limit
settings.text: Plaay reserves the right to limit or restrict replacements and refunds.
